sentences.en: Some insects can take on the color of their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 一些昆虫可以与周围环境的颜色融为一体。

sentences.en: Study lends a kind of enchantment to all our surroundings.
sentences.zh: 学习为我们的所有周遭增添了一种魔力。

sentences.en: The narrator provides only a few descriptions of the surroundings.
sentences.zh: 叙述者只对周围的环境进行了少量描述。

senses.zh: （周围的）环境事物,环境，周围的事物( surrounding的名词复数),一带
